1. GENERAL 
1.1. DOCUMENT OBJECTIVES 
This Service Level Agreement (SLA) establishes the framework for service delivery, ensuring 
that agreed -upon procedures, priorities, and escalation mechanisms are followed. The 
document specifies the scope of services provided, response and resolution targets, and related 
cost structures:  
 
1.2. SCOPE OF SERVICES 
The service will be undertaken by VITRONIC’s personnel, who are conversant with the systems 
to be supported. Support services provided by VITRONIC to Dubai Police will be in accordance 
with the procedures to be agreed: 
• On-site visits within an agreed Turnaround Time (TAT) if first-level support by remote has 
not failed to solve the issue. 
• Remote diagnostics and support using a secured connection to the Dubai Police network 
and ANPR Pool Service. 
• Assistance via telephone, email, or the JIRA ticketing system. 
1.3. SUPPORT WARRANTY 
VITRONIC will provide Dubai Police with technical support in accordance with the proposed 
terms of the technical proposal for the System Software including system 
Administration/Management performance tuning as well as fault diagnosis and repair on a 
Quarterly basis, which is running on Dubai Police  systems as described in the section for 
Supported Products. 
 
VITRONIC will provide services in accordance with the terms of the technical proposal by skilled 
personnel. However, the following also applies: 
• VITRONIC will take all reasonable steps to ensure that the staff supplied is best suited to 
deal with each Assignment. Although VITRONIC cannot guarantee particular staff being 
used on any Assignment.

• VITRONIC cannot supply staff having a specific familiarity with the Dubai Police  
Application Software. 
• It may be necessary for other VITRONIC personnel to become involved in a particular 
Assignment on an escalation basis. 
• Timelines for solutions involving System or Application Software changes must allow 
flexibility but include clear milestones to monitor progress and address delays effectively. 
 
If Dubai Police/VITRONIC recognizes that parts of the System Software may have functional 
limitations, such limitations should be carefully evaluated and categorized based on their 
operational impact. Functional limitations that do not disrupt operations may be documented as 
enhancement requirements for future consideration. However, if the limitation causes 
operational issues or impacts functionality, it must be treated as a fault condition or bug, requiring 
resolution as a priority. 
 
VITRONIC will ensure on all Assignments that the restoration/ re -establishment of a functional 
system is the first importance. 
1.4. FORCE MAJEURE 
The Company shall not be liable for any failure to comply with, or for any delay in, the 
performance of its obligations hereunder where such failure or delay is indirectly caused by, or 
in any manner arises or results from, events beyond the control of the  Company. These events 
shall include, but not be restricted to, Client’s governmental action, industrial dispute. If any such 
event shall continue for more than 90 days, either party may terminate the contract in respect of 
Services not yet delivered. 
1.5. SOFTWARE LICENSES 
VITRONIC will provide the necessary licenses for Vitronic application and associated software. However, 
Dubai Police shall be responsible for procuring these licenses in accordance with the terms and 
conditions outlined in the Main Contract. This excludes other licenses, such as Windows operating 
system licenses, SQL Server, Elasticsearch, MongoDB, or any other system software, which are not 
covered under this agreement. 
1.6. PERSONNEL 
Both parties undertake not to make any offers of employment to each other's employees who 
work on the system during the implementation of this Agreement and within twelve months after 
completion thereof. 
1.7. CONFIDENTIALITY 
The Company/ Customer shall not (and shall use its best endeavors to require that its employees 
shall not) during this Agreement or any time thereafter divulge or communicate to any person 
other than to officers or employees of the Customer/ Company whose province it is to know the 
same or on the written instructions of the Customer/ Company information concerning the 
Customer’s/ Company´s trade secrets, manufacturing processes or the business accounts

2. SERVICE AND MAINTENANCE 
2.1. INTRODUCTION 
The thinking and action of VITRONIC Services are focused on ensuring the ongoing operational 
satisfaction of the customer. In order to achieve this goal, VITRONIC provides services that are 
tailored to our specific technical solutions. In order to assure quality, our services are based on 
international standards in the same manner as our technical solutions. When providing and 
describing services, we are guided by the European Standard EN 13306:2001 as well as the 
Information Technology Infrastructure Libra ry (ITIL) for IT -Services of the British Office of 
Government Commerce (OGC).  
VITRONIC ANPR Pool Service are proven Traffic Monitoring and Traffic statistics incorporated 
within a full-service package to deliver both secure and reliable operation under the conditions 
specified in the tender documents. The services offered here include  1st, 2nd, and 3rd -level 
support, according to the annexed Service Level Agreement (SLA). 
 
2.2. TERMS AND DEFINITIONS  
2.2.1. METHODOLOGY 
The definitions will be based on the European Standard EN13306:2001 and the Information 
Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) for IT -Services of the British Office of Government 
Commerce (OGC).

reason (definition EN-Standard). 
An Incident Is any event that is not part of the standard operation of a service and that 
causes, or may cause an interruption to, or a reduction in, the quality of 
service (definition ITIL). 
Disabled states May occur by sudden failures, wear-out failures , aging failures , or 
degradation. 
Failure the event that an item or asset terminates its ability to perform a required 
function 
Fault The state of an item or asset after the occurrence of a failure 
Failure cause The reason leading up to a failure 
Problem Unknown underlying failure cause of one or more incidents. An incident 
may be rectified without knowing the failure caused by using a 
Workaround. 
Known Error An Incident or a Problem for which the failure cause is known and for 
which a temporary Workaround has been identified.

2.3. SUPPORT SERVICES   
A basic Support Services facility will be provided during the normal working hours ( Monday to 
Thursday 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM and Friday from 8:30 AM to 12:30 PM / excl. public holidays) to 
assist with issues of an operational or administrative nature encountered during the use of the 
Supported Products by Dubai Police. Dubai Police would contact VITRONIC’s Support Services 
via telephone e-mail or JIRA ticketing system. 
 
 
VITRONIC will provide a resident software support engineer to manage the tasks of planned 
maintenance and support Dubai Police  to manage the resolution of incidents of incurring 
problems (e.g. incident management). VITRONIC Experts will be also available to assist the 
support engineers with an incident resolution if required. For critical issues , a senior Expert is 
available and could be contacted by the Expert. All support skill levels need to be granted a 
remote connection. 
2.4. CONTINUOUS SOFTWARE MAINTENANCE UPDATES 
As software maintenance updates (bug fixes only) become available, VITRONIC will make such 
updates available to Dubai Police at no additional charge for the duration of the agreement. 
Software maintenance updates may be released either as a stand-alone product pre-release, or 
as part of a consolidated software maintenance release package. Generally, these updates will 
be distributed via JIRA, or via VITRONIC support engineer. 
VITRONIC will provide telephone assistance, as necessary, to assist with the implementation of 
the software updates.

Software maintenance updates generated by VITRONIC are intended for active support service 
subscribers. If an active support service agreement does not exist for a given product, an 
upgrade charge will apply. 
2.5. SOFTWARE CONFIGURATION SUPPORT   
VITRONIC will provide assistance, as necessary, to assist with the software configuration of 
Dubai Police systems. This is normally performed by remote access to Dubai Police systems. 
These services are scheduled in advance to ensure that the normal operation of Dubai Police 
systems is not adversely affected. 
2.6. SYSTEM AUDIT 
Dubai Police  may request that VITRONIC carry out on their behalf an additional scheduled 
program of system health checks, the primary purpose of these audits is to monitor the system 
performance and capacities and to notify Dubai Police of any current or impending issues. The 
precise nature of these checks is to be mutually agreed upon and is subject to the service fee 
schedule for the SLA. 
2.7. ON-SITE CONSULTANCY / SUPPORT SERVICES 
On-site consultancy and/or support services can be provided. The nature of these services can 
be flexible and is subject to the service fee schedule of the commercial proposal for the SLA. 
The scope needs to be agreed upon between Dubai Police  and VITRONIC. The services 
provided could address such topics as fault analysis, system optimization , and  system re -
engineering. Additionally, VITRONIC can provide business consultancy on a wide range of 
systems-related topics. 
Service Level: Unless agreed to in advance, on -site visits undertaken as part of the agreement 
may be subject to charges using the rates identified in the Service Fee Schedule section of the 
agreement. Reimbursable expenses would include: 
• Actual travel expenses incurred for airfare, hotel, meals, and local transportation. 
• Cost of manpower for all time spent on -site, plus travel time. Service rates would be at 
the pre-booked rate (where pre -booked or where the visit relates to the resolution of a 
Support Call previously placed) or at VITRONIC’s standard published rate (all o ther 
visits). 
• Other necessary and appropriate business expenses, as incurred. 
2.8. SYSTEM ADMINISTRATION 
For systems where there is no on -site System Administrator, VITRONIC can provide an 
administration service via remote or on-site access to the system. This service is only available 
by prior negotiation. 
 
 
2.9. TRAINING 
VITRONIC will provide tailored training courses as an integral part of the solution, covering all 
aspects of maintenance, operation, and administration specific to Dubai Police requirements.

2.10. APPLICATION SUPPORT 
VITRONIC can provide application support services on behalf of Dubai Police. Such services 
would allow for maintenance and debugging efforts associated with existing applications. 
Application development efforts associated with existing applications, or the development of new 
application interfaces would require a generation of a Professional Services Request (PSR). The 
PSR would define the scope of the work efforts to be performed and the associated charges. 
VITRONIC may offer additional support services t o assist with the operational requirements of 
Dubai Police with the operation and is subject to the service fee schedule of the commercial 
proposal for the SLA.

2.11. PRE-BOOKED SERVICES 
The Pre-Booked Services option is to be used when Dubai Police requests services not covered 
as a defined item within the Agreement, and these services will only be provided at Dubai Police 
explicit request. These services are separate from the application support, which is included in 
the Agreement.  
 
Efforts allocated to Pre-Booked Services will only be undertaken at the explicit request of Dubai  
Police. 
Pre-booked services are encouraged for all services anticipated outside of this schedule. All 
further involvement is chargeable at VITRONIC’s standard service rates. Efforts associated with 
resolution of reported faults will be performed under the terms of the agreement, and would not 
normally count against the Pre-Booked Service time. 
 
Service Level: This service is not covered within the scope of the agreement. 
 
3. CALL PROCEDURES 
In order that VITRONIC may provide the highest possible level of service to resolve an issue, in a 
timely and appropriate fashion, it is essential that Dubai Police observe the correct procedures with 
respect to reporting an issue. This section describes the procedures relating to the reporting of 
support calls to VITRONIC. 
VITRONIC implemented a web ticketing system “Jira” which is required to report support calls from 
Dubai Police.  
The tickets will be handled by Allocated Engineer / UAE Operation Support Engineers. For high-
level tickets, all teams will work together. 
 
3.1. CALL REPORTING 
Service calls may be reported to VITRONIC using the following contact information: 
 Jira Ticketing system and/or Email: ITD.Operation.ME@vitronic.com 
 
Service calls may be reported to VITRONIC using the attached contact information for any 
issues.  
 A callback should be received within one hour of placing the service call during the hours of 
support covered by the agreement. 
In order to respond to a fault, call in a timely and appropriate fashion, when placing a service 
call, Dubai Police will be asked for the following information: 
• Dubai Police Contact Name 
• Corresponding tracking number in use by Dubai Police 
• Name of person reporting the fault 
• Name of person to be contacted on site (if different from above)

On placing a service call, VITRONIC’s Support Services group will allocate a unique tracking 
number which will be given to Dubai Police, and this should be quoted in any future

VITRONIC’s Support Services group should be used as a central contact point for fault 
progression and escalation. 
 
3.2. CALL PROGRESS 
Once a call has been received by VITRONIC from Dubai Police, VITRONIC will contact Dubai 
Police to establish the exact nature of the problem and begin the fault resolution process. 
Dubai Police will be kept informed of progress on the call, including what action has been taken 
to resolve the problem and the time the call was closed. 
A Service Call activity is generally a serial work process. The agreement allows us to work on a 
maximum of 2 Service Calls in parallel. 
 
3.3. CALL CLOSURE 
When the problem has been resolved, the call will be closed on VITRONIC’s call tracking system 
and Dubai Police will be informed of the following: 
• The time and date the call was closed by VITRONIC. 
• A brief description of the action taken.

4.1. PRIORITY P1 (CRITICAL) 
A P1 call is used for system faults where there is a major impact on the normal operation of the 
system. VITRONIC will immediately begin work on a P1 call, with the immediate goal of 
restoring normal operation to the system via a fault correction or a satisfactory workaround. 
Misuse of this priority affects the ability of VITRONIC to respond to genuine P1 calls. 
 
4.2. PRIORITY P2 (URGENT) 
A P2 call is used for system faults where normal system operation is affected to some degree 
and a satisfactory workaround is not available. VITRONIC will use its best endeavors to respond

to the call at the times stated in the Response Times section of this document. In most cases, it 
is normal for VITRONIC to respond in faster times than those stated. 
4.3. PRIORITY P3 (STANDARD) 
A P3 call is used for system faults where a fault was detected, but normal operation is not 
affected. This priority of call is the default for all service calls that are not related to P1/P2 calls. 
For software-related issues, this priority allows for work to be scheduled as part of a planned 
maintenance update.  
 
4.4. PRIORITY P4 (ENHANCEMENT REQUESTS) 
A P4 call is used when an enhancement request is made for potential modifications to System 
Software. 
 
4.5. Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Reports 
For all incidents, irrespective of severity, a Root Cause Analysis (RCA) report shall be prepared 
and shared with the Client within forty -eight (48) hours of issue resolution. This requirement 
applies across all severity levels to ensure transparency, accountability, and continuous service 
improvement. 
 
4.6. PENALTIES 
The resolution level will define the percentage of incidents that fall within the commitments that 
are given for all types of failures. In case the vendor fails to meet the target resolution levels, A 
deduction from the monthly payment will be applied on the next invoice as per table below. The 
target resolution level will be counted on a monthly average. The deduction percentage will also 
be applied to the next monthly or quarterly fee for the SLA. 
When the SLA contract is ended, the possible credit resulting from the performance from the last 
quarter will be deducted from the invoice for the last quarter and payment will be deferred until 
the end of the quarter. 
The target resolution level is calculated as a percentage of the actual time taken to resolve the 
total number of incidents compared to the resolution time.

5. ESCALATION PROCEDURES 
VITRONIC will use all reasonable endeavors to ensure that calls are cleared within the specified timescales 
in the agreement. If the event calls remain outstanding beyond the agreed times, VITRONIC’s Support staff 
will escalate the call to the Customer Success Manager at VITRONIC, who will contact his counterpart within 
the Dubai Police organization to agree on a course of action to be taken. 
5.1. ESCALATION TIMES 
As a call is escalated, regular contact will be maintained between the VITRONIC SLA team and 
a nominated and designated member of the Dubai Police organization.
